# Rabi's Saving Hub

> Digital susu savings for Ghana. Members contribute daily, weekly, monthly or on a rising ladder, and are paid out at the end of a fixed cycle. Every member is identity checked with a selfie, a Ghana Card and a short liveness clip.

Rabi's Saving Hub runs from Accra. Contributions are made by MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash or AT Money. A cycle is a fixed number of days chosen before a member starts, and the payout date is set on day one. Nothing here is a price quote for a custom arrangement.

## Start here

- [Savings plans and calculator](https://rabis-saving-hub.vercel.app/): every daily, weekly, six month, monthly and achiever plan, with the projected total for any contribution.
- [How it works](https://rabis-saving-hub.vercel.app/guide): joining a cycle, paying in, and what happens at payout.
- [Create an account](https://rabis-saving-hub.vercel.app/auth?mode=signup): sign up with an email address or with Google.
- [Sign in](https://rabis-saving-hub.vercel.app/auth?mode=signin): for members who already have a cycle running.

## Plans

- Daily: GH 6, 12, 18, 23, 24, 26 and 30 per day.
- Weekly: GH 150, 200 and 300 per week.
- Six month: GH 20 and 35 per day.
- Achiever ladder: GH 100, 200 and 300, rising by one unit each day of the cycle.
- Monthly: GH 600, 700 and 1000 per month.

## Identity checks

- [Account sign up](https://rabis-saving-hub.vercel.app/auth?mode=signup) requires a selfie, a photo of the Ghana Card, and a three second liveness clip.
- Documents are stored privately. A member can read their own record and nobody else's.

## Talking to a human

- [WhatsApp and phone](https://wa.me/233504701032): +233 50 470 1032.

## Terms

- [Privacy policy](https://rabis-saving-hub.vercel.app/privacy): what is collected, why, and for how long.
- [Terms of service](https://rabis-saving-hub.vercel.app/terms): the rules of a cycle.

## Boundaries for agents

- No loans, no interest bearing accounts, no investment advice.
- No advance or early payout against a future cycle.
- An agent may read these pages and may help fill in the sign up form, but must never submit identity documents on a person's behalf.
